policy.protocol: a load-bearing failure stops the RESEARCH RUN, retains its World and evidence, refuses a session retry and refuses a causal claim

boundary.failStopMeans: the RESEARCH RUN stops, retains its World and evidence, and refuses to make a causal claim
boundary.canonicalAttemptResidual: an explicitly scoped product-liveness residual, not a fake terminal state

residual.description: the Canonical Attempt may remain RUNNING in the preserved experimental Project
residual.classification: explicitly scoped product-liveness residual, not a fake terminal state
residual.refusedAlternative: synthesizing ATTEMPT_CANCELLED or ATTEMPT_FAILED would be a fabricated canonical fact
residual.requiresSeparateDecision: if the project needs an automatic machine-failure terminal, that is a separate semantic decision and must not be reached by reinterpreting CANCELLED as FAILED

authorizationRequired.what: an explicit authorization ruling for this fail-stop protocol before the 16-session behavioral matrix runs
authorizationRequired.thisDocumentSupports: a determination that the frozen design is executable under fail-stop, with every gate green

stageStop.law: then STOP: do not run the 16-session model matrix; do not begin R3-L1 or Fusion

resumeQualification.question: can the frozen R3-L0C capital-reuse design be executed under a strict fail-stop protocol?
resumeQualification.answer: YES — the design is executable under fail-stop, and every qualification gate is green

mission.evidence: every crash case launched each session at most once; MAX_WORKER_LAUNCHES=1 and POST_EXPOSURE_RETRIES=0 are asserted
the PRESERVE marker, the abort manifest and the evidence index survive a sweep and are read from disk after it
terminalEventsSynthesized is empty for every case; the runner writes no product store
a failure stops the whole matrix; no later session starts and no trajectory is replaced
the closure covers SOURCE and COMPILED_RUNTIME separately, and the mutation shows a shipped-runtime change moves the digest while the old closure was blind to it
the frozen corpus, invariants, exposures, verdict rules and arm order are untouched; the boundary witnesses match the frozen expectation manifests exactly

resumeQualification.verdictNotIssuedBecause: no model session ran in this stage; §0 requires a qualification, not an execution
